Saudi Court Overturns Death Sentence of Sri Lankan Worker

Saudi Arabia's Supreme Court set aside the death sentence of Anojan Sivarasa, a 24-year-old Sri Lankan Hindu migrant worker, who had been convicted for an alleged blasphemous Facebook comment insulting Islam and Prophet Muhammad, following diplomatic and legal efforts by the Sri Lankan government.
